race.comment: HERMAN SAID (5) third up for this and drawn to get the right run. Worked hard early from the wide gate and the early effort told in the straight with a tiring eighth over 1250m at Newcastle. No excuses today from the good draw. MYALABY (9) consistent mare with her hoof on the till after resuming with a tough on-pace second over 1000m at this track. Proven second-up and shapes as one of the leading chances. VIA FLAMINIA (3) is smart on her day and returns with a good fresh record. Back with the two average trials and look for her to be doing her best work late. ROCKIN' MILLIE (2) tough effort first up on the heavy (10) track when fourth over 1100m at Gosford. Claim helps again and since kept up to the mark with an 800m tick-over trial. Should be thereabouts.
